title: 200Tdi-Powered 1991 Land Rover Defender Otokar 110 5-Speed

highlights: Transmission reportedly rebuilt under prior ownership
Recent cooling system, starter, alternator, injector work reported
red_flags: Multiple commenters note inconsistencies between exterior and engine-bay photos (snorkel/air intake routing doesn't match)
Possible non-original frame repairs/fabrication noted by a commenter
Seller's claim of sustained 90mph highway speeds disputed as implausible by commenters
normalized.prelim_summary: This is a 1991 Otokar-built Land Rover Defender 110 retrofitted with a 200Tdi diesel and 5-speed manual, showing about 43k miles and offered at no reserve from a Pennsylvania dealer. The seller describes extensive recent mechanical work and a trouble-free driving experience, but several commenters flag photo inconsistencies around the intake/snorkel setup and possible frame repairs that remain unaddressed. Buyers should press for direct verification of the engine bay and chassis before bidding.
